source.title: Storm heavy tank
source.author: RGriffin65
source.notes: Vehicle rework (LANCE-19, 2026-10-30), differs from the mech text above: no joints or actuators. The fit is level (`no_icp` in storm_veh.json; the v1 ICP tilted the kit). The kit's fused hull was split by `tools/art/v3/veh_prep.py` (storm_prep.json) into the hull (the kit's tread label merged in), the turret (`TankGTurret`, turns about the vertical axis; re-seated on the hull ring, because the v1 mount had centred its long barrels on the model's turret pivot and floated it 2.7 m aft), the barrels with their housings (`TankGguns`, the gun: elevates about the housing centre) and two track belts (`track_l`, `track_r`: the faces within 100 mm of the closed belt path round the wheels). The seven wheels a side (`wheel_l0`..`wheel_r6`) are OWN GEOMETRY (`make_wheel`: tyre drum, recessed rim, hub boss, bolts) on axles fitted to the kit's wheel circles; the kit's wheel faces were cut from the hull. This own geometry is part of the CC BY-SA 4.0 derivative. 7,701 needle triangles left on the turret by the kit's simplification were dropped. Welded at 3 mm and planar-dissolved at 8 degrees, no collapse; belts on a tread strip of two link pitches (0.425 m) by `veh_lowpoly.py`.

tracks_note: both belts share one tread strip (v0, v_len, belt_m): veh_lowpoly.py maps each belt's arclength modulo belt_m (2 link pitches) into it, track_l in the left half of the atlas strip, track_r in the right; v increases toward the rear on the visible ground run
